message:
In the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) retrofit (C1), the off-tune verification method has asymmetric coverage. To check it I used review of the detuned damping estimate (E8) with the off-tune check (E13). I found 0.136 metres per second squared at plus 5 percent detune with no minus 5 percent value, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose Vibration Control Specialist, please add minus 5 percent acceleration and stroke. My position: not ready because blocking process check remains open.

In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the bolted connection sign-off method has pending formal closure. To check it I used review of the repeated check calculation (E10) with the midspan stress increment (E12). I found 3924 Newtons static load with about 2.5 Megapascals girder stress, according to Eurocode 3, 2005. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead, please confirm fatigue-non-critical status in one sentence. My position: not ready because support safety sign-off is pending.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: off-tune plus side done, minus side requested.
Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: stress numbers given, closure sentence needed.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: peak load quantified, awaiting companion closure.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: comfort threshold met, proposal on hold pending blocks.
